newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P ASSIGNS BBB- TO DAEWOO CORP.
newsitem.headline: S&P ASSIGNS BBB- TO DAEWOO CORP.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Tuesday it had assigned its BBB- corporate credit rating to Daewoo Corp.

At the same time the rating agency said it had assigned its BBB- rating to $327,110,751.33 in Daewoo Grantor Trust 1997-A pass through certificates due in 2008, which benefit from a guarantee of the underlying assets by Daewoo Corp.
The rating outlook is stable, S&P said.
Daewoo's rating is based on its stable business and earnings profile as a major trading company for the Daewoo Group, and solid profitability from its successful construction business, S&P said.
However, it said Daewoo's strengths are somewhat offset by increasing investment exposure as a result of the group's aggressive expansion strategy and its leveraged financial profile.
